consume-input-once.reference_claim: The supplied iterable is traversed by one forward loop.

preserve-rejected-identity.reference_claim: The original rejected object is appended directly.

do-not-mutate-inputs.reference_claim: Resolved values remain local and input notices are unchanged.

snapshot-clock-once.reference_claim: One time snapshot is shared by every classification.

delegate-channel-resolution.reference_claim: Every channel decision is delegated to the injected policy.

preserve-rejection-order.reference_claim: Rejections are appended during the original forward traversal.
